content.text:
Finding submitted.

**TRANSITION — deviation (fallback cure inserted).**

- **What exists:** Section 5.2 a) ii) requires MSL to "assist in the transfer of MSL responsibilities and Products … to IBM or to another party that IBM designates," but the chapeau (p0121) limits Section 5.2 a) to "expiration or termination **for default**," and no duration is committed. Section 5.2 a) iii) returns only IBM Product documentation and confidential media on a redacted "[*] Days" clock — not a data export within a fixed 30 days.
- **What doesn't:** Section 12.0 / Supplement 1 "Transition Services" are inbound-only and expired 31 Dec 1998; Attachment 6 §3 (MS Software Image media) and §12.1 (Loaned Items) are asset-return, not exit assistance or data return.
- **Cure:** one new Section 5.2 d) carrying exactly the three fallback elements — any-reason expiry/termination trigger, ≥90 Days of assistance (by cross-reference to the existing 5.2 a) ii) obligation, so nothing is duplicated), and a 30-Day export of all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for IBM. Preferred extras (six months, then-current rates, machine-readable format, certified deletion) were deliberately not volunteered.
